text:
alex: Quick follow-up — we need a minimal 'deployment fingerprint' for Hosted/Dedicated/Private so clients can do deterministic fallbacks without probing.

jordan: +1. Minimal set of flags would help.

jordan: propose: stream=true|false, kv_cache=true|false, kms=integrated|proxy|none, max_seq_len=int, offload=allowed|forbidden

sam: prefer machine-readable manifest + a standard UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE error code. client falls back immediately.

marta: KMS semantics are tricky. If kms!=integrated we can't return persistent keys. audit implications.

raj: Agreed. For Private deployments we require 'kms=integrated' for any persistent encryption. Otherwise fail-closed.

devon: Telemetry: include 'telemetry_endpoint' and 'sampling_rate' so console can route traces & costs.

alex: Example manifest (JSON):
```json
{
  "stream": true,
  "kv_cache": false,
  "kms": "proxy",
  "max_seq_len": 4096,
  "offload": "forbidden",
  "telemetry_endpoint": "https://ingest.redwood-internal",
  "sampling_rate": 0.01
}
```

sam: error code suggestion: UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE (4xx), TRANSIENT_CAPACITY (5xx), AUTHZ_REQUIRED (4xx). Keep it small.

jordan: +1 to codes. Also add 'grace_window' for clients to retry with backoff before switching models.

marta: ops note: manifest must be signed for Private. add 'manifest_signature' and 'manifest_version'.

infra-bot: scheduled test job: hosted->dedicated fallback run queued (job id j-9843)

alex: Action: I'll spin RFC with schema + sample client patch. @sam to own client fallbacks. Can folks ack by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:
